definitions.explanation: The act of protecting and maintaining something in its current state, preventing damage or loss. Used for natural environments, security, and equipment maintenance.

examples.japanese: {環境|かんきょう}{保全|ほぜん}に{取|と}り{組|く}む。
{生態系|せいたいけい}の{保全|ほぜん}が{急務|きゅうむ}となっている。
examples.english: The preservation of ecosystems has become an urgent matter.

examples.japanese: {設備|せつび}の{保全|ほぜん}{活動|かつどう}を{定期的|ていきてき}に{実施|じっし}している。
examples.english: We carry out equipment maintenance activities regularly.

notes:
Used in both environmental and industrial/technical contexts. In environmental contexts, similar to {保護|ほご} (protection) but emphasizes maintaining the current state rather than active intervention. In industrial contexts, refers to maintenance work to keep equipment running properly.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{環境|かんきょう}{保全|ほぜん} (environmental conservation)
・{自然|しぜん}{保全|ほぜん} (nature conservation)
・{安全|あんぜん}{保全|ほぜん} (safety maintenance)
・{設備|せつび}{保全|ほぜん} (facility/equipment maintenance)
・{保全|ほぜん}{活動|かつどう} (conservation activities)
